_about: The board shape for the Recipe Shorts SAMPLE only. Your project's types, columns and fields come from your own work and are agreed before anything is built (docs/board.md). Each item type is its own board (its own columns), so one workspace holds the Recipe board and the Post board side by side. Each entry under 'types' is the --args object for one `type.add` command; 'after' lists follow-up commands, including the buttons on the columns the owner presses (status.actions).

workspace.name: Recipe Shorts
workspace.description: Pipeline for a recipe channel: Shorts (the Recipe board) and kitchen-tip community posts (the Post board), built, reviewed and scheduled by agents.

after.why: A paused or retired agent's timer must not fire. This command previews first and returns a confirm code.
The owner's approval. Reject asks for the reason the ideas agent learns from.
The builder's column. [] means no buttons: the guessed one would move work nobody built.
The reviewer approves; the owner can still overrule it, always with a reason. No Approve button, so a press cannot skip the review.
The builder's column. Without this the guess would offer Move to Approved, skipping review.
Waiting for the publisher; the owner can still pull it back with the fix list.
After the owner does what the agent could not (a sign-in), the card goes back to the publisher. The guess would have been Move to Scheduled.
The go-live check moves it to Published; nothing for a person to press.
